title: Version Sorting
description: sort_versions(versions) sorts version strings like "1.10" and "1.9" from oldest to newest. The key function splits on dots, which looks right...
code:
def sort_versions(versions):
    return sorted(versions, key=lambda v: v.split("."))
solution:
def sort_versions(versions):
    return sorted(versions, key=lambda v: [int(part) for part in v.split(".")])
hint: Is "10" less than "9"? As strings, yes.
explanation: Splitting gives lists of strings, and strings compare character by character: "10" < "9" because "1" < "9". Convert each part to `int` so the parts compare as numbers.
